symbols.name: Nat
symbols.semantics: Natural number (only bounded natural literals used for real constants).

symbols.name: Real
symbols.semantics: Real scalar ℝ.

symbols.name: Point
symbols.semantics: The fixed Euclidean plane ℝ × ℝ with standard real norm, topology and Lebesgue volume.

symbols.name: ScalarFunction
symbols.semantics: A total function (ℝ × ℝ) → ℝ, without implicit regularity.

symbols.name: Dual
symbols.semantics: A continuous real-linear map (ℝ × ℝ) →L[ℝ] ℝ.

symbols.name: DualField
symbols.semantics: A function (ℝ × ℝ) → ((ℝ × ℝ) →L[ℝ] ℝ).

symbols.name: Set
symbols.semantics: A set of planar points Set (ℝ × ℝ).

symbols.name: RealFunction
symbols.semantics: A total function ℝ → ℝ.

symbols.name: real_nat
symbols.semantics: Cast the supplied natural literal to ℝ.

symbols.name: real_add
symbols.semantics: Ordered real addition x+y.

symbols.name: real_sub
symbols.semantics: Ordered real subtraction x-y.

symbols.name: real_mul
symbols.semantics: Real multiplication x*y.

symbols.name: point
symbols.semantics: Ordered pair (x,y); first argument is the horizontal coordinate.

symbols.name: fst
symbols.semantics: First coordinate z.1.

symbols.name: snd
symbols.semantics: Second coordinate z.2.

symbols.name: zero_dual
symbols.semantics: The zero continuous linear functional.

symbols.name: zero_function
symbols.semantics: The identically zero planar scalar function.

symbols.name: apply
symbols.semantics: Function evaluation f(z).

symbols.name: dual_apply
symbols.semantics: Evaluation A(v) of a continuous linear functional on a direction.

symbols.name: field_apply
symbols.semantics: Evaluation of derivative field A at point z; returns A(z).

symbols.name: fderiv_field
symbols.semantics: The totalized field z ↦ fderiv ℝ f z. Differentiability is not implicit.

symbols.name: divergence
symbols.semantics: For derivatives A=Df and B=Dg, z ↦ A(z)(1,0)+B(z)(0,1). Operator itself does not assert those derivative premises.

symbols.name: curl
symbols.semantics: For derivatives A=DP and B=DQ, scalar curl z ↦ B(z)(1,0)-A(z)(0,1), in that order.

symbols.name: closed_rectangle
symbols.semantics: Set.Icc a b, with componentwise order; empty if an endpoint order is reversed.

symbols.name: open_rectangle
symbols.semantics: Set.Ioo a.1 b.1 ×ˢ Set.Ioo a.2 b.2. Both coordinates must be strictly inside.

symbols.name: set_difference
symbols.semantics: Set difference s \ t.

symbols.name: member
symbols.semantics: Point membership z ∈ s.

symbols.name: countable
symbols.semantics: Set.Countable s; no differentiability exemption is implicit.

symbols.name: has_fderiv
symbols.semantics: has_fderiv(f,z,A) means HasFDerivAt f A z. Point precedes derivative in XML; Lean takes derivative before point.

symbols.name: continuous_on
symbols.semantics: ContinuousOn f s, including relative continuity at the boundary when s is closed.

symbols.name: cont_diff_one
symbols.semantics: ContDiff ℝ 1 f on the entire plane. It is a genuine global C¹ hypothesis.

symbols.name: integrable_on
symbols.semantics: MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn f s with standard product Lebesgue volume.

symbols.name: set_integral
symbols.semantics: Bochner integral ∫ z in s, f z with standard product Lebesgue volume, totalized as in Lean.

symbols.name: horizontal_slice
symbols.semantics: For f and fixed y, the function x ↦ f(x,y).

symbols.name: vertical_slice
symbols.semantics: For f and fixed x, the function y ↦ f(x,y).

symbols.name: interval_integral
symbols.semantics: Oriented interval integral ∫ t in a..b, h t. Endpoints a,b are not silently reordered.

symbols.name: affine
symbols.semantics: affine(α,β,p)(x,y)=α*x+β*y+p.

symbols.name: boundary_flux
symbols.semantics: For field (f,g), endpoints a,b: (∫x=a₁..b₁ g(x,b₂) - ∫x=a₁..b₁ g(x,a₂)) + ∫y=a₂..b₂ f(b₁,y) - ∫y=a₂..b₂ f(a₁,y). With a≤b this is outward flux: top−bottom+right−left. Without ordered endpoints it is only this signed formula.

symbols.name: boundary_circulation
symbols.semantics: For one-form P dx+Q dy, endpoints a,b: ∫x=a₁..b₁ P(x,a₂) + ∫y=a₂..b₂ Q(b₁,y) - ∫x=a₁..b₁ P(x,b₂) - ∫y=a₂..b₂ Q(a₁,y). With a≤b this traverses bottom/right/top/left counterclockwise.

symbols.name: forall
symbols.semantics: Universal quantification over explicitly typed, nonshadowing bound variables.

symbols.name: exists
symbols.semantics: Existential quantification over explicitly typed, nonshadowing bound variables.

symbols.name: type
symbols.semantics: Type annotation on a quantified variable only.

symbols.name: and
symbols.semantics: Logical conjunction.

symbols.name: or
symbols.semantics: Logical disjunction.

symbols.name: implies
symbols.semantics: Logical implication, antecedent first.

symbols.name: equivalent
symbols.semantics: Logical equivalence.

symbols.name: not
symbols.semantics: Logical negation.

symbols.name: eq
symbols.semantics: Equality of two values of identical type.

symbols.name: neq
symbols.semantics: Inequality of two values of identical type.

symbols.name: leq
symbols.semantics: Numeric ≤, left argument first.

symbols.name: lt
symbols.semantics: Numeric strict <, left argument first.

symbols.name: plus
symbols.semantics: Addition of two values of the same numeric type.
